input.quote: HDI shall also provide the Company with access to HDI's software and Content administration tools for purposes of allowing the Company to monitor current catalog information.
input.rationale:
Section 1.4 is the only grant running in our favour (access to and the right to use HDI's hosting system, software and Content administration tools). It is silent on affiliates and on contractors acting on our behalf, with no mechanism to add them — that fails even the fallback (affiliates covered on written notice), and our Site operations rely on third-party support. It is also silent on revocability, so HDI could argue the access is withdrawable at will. The successor element is largely addressed by Section 10.3 (Agreement binds and benefits successors and assigns), so the redline mainly adds affiliate/contractor coverage and irrevocability during the term absent our uncured material breach. The outbound Marks licence in Section 6.1 runs in our favour as licensor and is not flagged.</rationale>

ops.text: The access and use rights granted to the Company under this Section 1.4 extend to the Company's affiliates and to contractors acting on the Company's behalf, are irrevocable during the term of this Agreement except in the case of an uncured material breach by the Company, and may be transferred to any successor to the Company's business by merger, acquisition or sale of all or substantially all of its assets.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the Section 1.4 access and use rights to our affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, since they operate and support the Site for us, and confirmed the rights are irrevocable during the term save for our uncured material breach and pass to a successor. If preferred, we can accept affiliate coverage on written notice to HDI instead.
proposal.summary: Extend the Section 1.4 access/use rights to Company affiliates and contractors, make them irrevocable during the term absent uncured material breach, and confirm transfer to a successor.

mappings.element: Licence extended to contractors acting on Customer's behalf.
